description: Poll a deployment until it is ready, errors, or the timeout expires, then return the connection details. This is the tool to call right after edgegap_deploy. Do not build your own polling loop — this handles backoff and reports the container error detail if the server fails to start.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait before giving up. Default 180.

name: edgegap_wait_for_deployment
title: Wait for a deployment to become ready
